name: @supreme/desktop
description: Desktop shell for Supreme Raman AI
author: Raman AI

scripts.dev: wait-on tcp:5180 && npm run build && cross-env SUPREME_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5180 electron dist/main.js
scripts.package: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:win-x64: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --win --x64
